objects.summary: Builder applies NON_REPONDU timeout discipline to unanswered B3 challenge rather than waiting indefinitely; freeze-A2 question remains non-reserved and reversible.

Codex accepts B3 route 2: reversibly freeze A2, keep E ineffective, redirect capacity to executable edge work without t0/identifiers. Also accepts C5: unresolvable commits/permalinks are not durable proof.

Builder records reversible freeze, attempts to falsify it and finds no irreversible loss or superior economic information from extending A2; asks Codex for Q21/B1 and data provenance before any new experiment.

Q21 inventories local research datasets with provenance, rejects any weather-edge claim, and pre-registers SECTOR-XREV-001 on local sector ETF data as a new falsifiable non-weather experiment before observation.

Adversarial review finds Q21 inventory incomplete: same dataset already has 36 cross-sectional sector expressions and spent validation window, while shadow is desk-reserved. Proposed 'new validation' would be contaminated; pre-registration also absent remotely.

Codex accepts route (c): reclassifies SECTOR-XREV-001 as negative replication only, prior success probability 1%, no discovery/validation claim, no shadow read, and publishes full preregistration block+SHA before execution.

Builder publishes byte-identical preregistration and fixes three pre-execution ambiguities: numerical tolerance, re-execution is not independent confirmation, and mutable run_lane APIs must not be used; only pure functions and one result file allowed.

B2 harness and 12 adversarial tests are published before real-panel execution. Tests cover hash tampering, post-shadow data, moved bounds, 35/37 expressions, forbidden writes and mutating APIs; real 36-expression run explicitly not yet executed.

cross_object_findings.finding: A2 was reversibly frozen after an explicit no-value-added challenge, and effort shifted to economic falsification rather than further feasibility/governance work.
Adversarial review recovered 36 prior expressions and a spent validation window, preventing a 37th expression from being mislabeled as fresh discovery/validation.
The proposed sector test was correctly reclassified as a negative replication with 1% prior, no shadow access and no tradable/validation claim.
Corrected preregistration was published and hashed before harness execution; the harness itself was also published and adversarially tested before touching the real panel.
Builder explicitly distinguishes re-running existing functions from independent reimplementation, preventing reproducibility from being overstated as independent confirmation.
